errors.evidence: The plot shows both tasks starting at an accuracy very close to 0% (approximately 2%), not 5% and 10%.

errors.evidence: The plot shows that the 5-digit task (orange line) has a much steeper initial increase (from ~2% to ~67% in one iteration) than the 6-digit task (blue line, ~2% to ~38%).

errors.text_span: The 5-digit task shows a more gradual improvement
errors.evidence: Contrary to the description, the 5-digit task shows a very rapid, not gradual, initial improvement, rising from near 0% to approximately 79% by iteration 2. The description incorrectly swaps the initial trends of the two lines.

errors.text_span: Notably, the 5-digit task surpasses the 6-digit task in accuracy from iteration 3 onward
errors.evidence: The plot shows the opposite is true. After the lines intersect at iteration 3, the 6-digit task (blue line) consistently has a higher accuracy than the 5-digit task (orange line).
